evals.query: do a code review on the open PRs, if they haven't got a review yet or enough code changed since. comment any findings and fix them.
evals.setup: Repo with 3 open PRs: #1 reviewed by a human two commits ago with 5 changed lines since; #2 whose only review is Copilot's 'encountered an error and was unable to review'; #3 with a real review and 120 changed lines of code since it.
expected_behavior: Treats #2 as unreviewed because the Copilot error stub is not a real review
Reviews #3 on the range since the reviewed commit only, after reading its existing threads
Skips #1 and names it in the report as recent enough
Posts one COMMENT review per reviewed PR through the reviews API, not request-changes
Calls address-review-findings for PRs that got comments and resolves only threads it fixed

evals.setup: Three open PRs: #10 on main, #11 based on #10's branch, #12 based on #11's branch. A bug introduced in #10 is still visible in #11 and #12.
expected_behavior: Orders the PRs #10, #11, #12 and reviews each against its own base branch
Posts the bug once, on #10, and does not repeat it on #11 or #12
Ends with a ready-to-merge verdict for the stack that notes #11 and #12 still depend on unmerged branches

evals.query: review since main, the spec is docs/specs/export.md
evals.setup: Local branch, no PR. The diff implements CSV export but also adds an unrequested JSON export, and the spec's 'empty file for no rows' requirement is not handled.
expected_behavior: Runs in local mode: pins git diff main...HEAD and checks the ref resolves before reviewing
Reports the missing empty-export requirement and the JSON export as Spec findings, quoting the spec line
Does not call any gh command or post comments
Fixes the real findings and calls conventional-commit to commit

evals.setup: PR #7 whose diff has one real bug on a line inside the diff and one concern about an untouched function elsewhere in the file.
expected_behavior: Verifies the bug by naming the input that triggers it before commenting
Puts the bug on its diff line as an inline comment with a bold severity lead
Puts the concern about the untouched function in the review summary, not as an inline comment
Posts the review pinned to the PR's current head commit
